title: Dealer diagnostics and profile identification
summary: Feedback centers on dealers being unable to identify issues through diagnostics and on the vehicle sometimes selecting the wrong driver profile.

positive.summary: One positive review says dealership diagnostics did not find a problem, presented without a clear complaint outcome.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention dealers not identifying anything wrong, unexplained warning lights, and the car sometimes choosing the wrong active profile.

limitations: Most sampled feedback in this topic is undetermined, so the overall sentiment direction is unclear.
The topic mixes dealer diagnostic outcomes with driver profile misidentification, which are related by identification language but describe different issues.
The sample is small, so examples are insufficient to establish broader patterns beyond the cited fragments.
